sql.query: UPDATE tbl_event_statuses es SET es.isDefault=0,es.modifiedByUserId=:userId,es.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE es.tenantId=:tenantId AND :isDefault=1 AND es.id<>NULLIF(:id,0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:authorisedUserId AND utr.tenantId=es.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)

INSERT INTO tbl_event_statuses (id,tenantId,statusName,systemCategory,displayOrder,colour,isActive,isDefault,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT NULLIF(:id,0),:tenantId,TRIM(:statusName),:systemCategory,:displayOrder,:colour,CASE WHEN :isDefault=1 THEN 1 ELSE :isActive END,:isDefault2,:userId,:userId2 FROM DUAL WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(:statusName2),'') IS NOT NULL AND :systemCategory2 IN ('planned','active','on_hold','completed','cancelled','archived') AND :colour2 REGEXP '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:authorisedUserId AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND utr.isActive=1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE statusName=VALUES(statusName),systemCategory=VALUES(systemCategory),displayOrder=VALUES(displayOrder),colour=VALUES(colour),isActive=VALUES(isActive),isDefault=VALUES(isDefault),modifiedByUserId=VALUES(modifiedByUserId),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
